# dsh-plugins-update
> Most features of this project have been built into dsh 0.2.2-rc.1, and the project is now archived
Most features of this project have been built into dsh 0.2.2-rc.1, and the project is now archived.
A minimal one-click updater for third-party DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugins.
Adds an update button to every third-party plugin detail page in DSH, with proactive update reminder
s on the sidebar and installed plugin list.
## Features

- Injected into the native `plugins.detail.actions` slot;
- Proactive startup update reminders: disp
lays an `Update available` tag on updatable rows in the installed plugin list and a total count badg

e on the sidebar `Plugins` entry;
- Smart probe deduplication: unapplied update reminders persist ac
ross restarts without re-probing known updatable plugins on startup, while opening a plugin's detail
page always performs a live check (with cached fallback on offline/timeout) to catch newer cross-ve

ate with post-install disk version verification;
- Registry configuration: npm official, npmmirror a

and `Tag` components;
- Update button, reminder badges, and settings card follow the DSH language se

ag` components;
- Update button, reminder badges, and settings card follow the DSH language setting.
Not included: progress percentage, install logs, cancellation, update history, GitHub tag/commit tra
cluded: progress percentage, install logs, cancellation, update history, GitHub tag/commit tracking.
## Compatibility & Protection Mechanisms
- **Dual-Path Backend Detection**: Startup batch checks read DSH's runtime `installer` service first
and automatically fall back to scanning `package.json` and `node_modules/*/package.json` on disk, e

nsuring update detection remains unaffected by DSH internal API changes.
- **Semantic Anchoring & Si
lent Degradation**: Sidebar count badges and plugin row tags anchor on semantic attributes (`li[data
-plugin-package]`, WAI-ARIA `[role="switch"]`, and `sidebar.panellist` metadata) rather than hashed
CSS class names, and all DOM operations are isolated inside `try / catch` boundaries. If a future DS
H major update restructures the outer layout, badges degrade silently without impacting conversation

s, page rendering, or the detail-page update button.
- **Cross-Version & Offline Fallback**: If a pl
ugin skips an intermediate release (e.g. `0.1` -> `0.2`), entering its detail page triggers a live v
ersion probe to upgrade directly to the newest version (`0.2`), and falls back to the cached update
target if a transient network timeout occurs.
